column9: 5 bit-exact variants measured out before commit: k_ab tiny loads batched (67us unchanged, bandwidth-bound), k_ab on st2 beside the in GEMV (-0.5% decode), register/shuffle FWHT in k_xq (39->44us), Veltkamp f16r in k_fv (2.29->2.42ms), transpose-reduce k_fs FAK=8 (0.82->0.88ms)
k_gdn default 2 rows per warp chain x 2 warps per block

k_fvg: 2 heads of a KV group x 2 dims per thread, V loaded+converted once for both heads (bench k_fv 2.288->2.085 ms); prescreened out: fused k_gnorm->k_xq (neutral), unconditional Veltkamp f16r with exact fallback (2.29->2.64 ms)

ping-pong prompt staging buffers: host embeds chunk k+1 while GPU runs chunk k, no per-chunk stream sync (400-tok prefill +1.1% same job); prescreened out: smem-tree k_fs reductions, conversion-free K in k_fs, parallel prefix-max k_fw (all bit-identical, none faster)
on-GPU embed / pipelined decode measured out before coding: removing every per-step host sync (fixed token) gives 10.79 -> 10.81 tok/s decode (0.2-0.5%, below noise)
k_ab with ABU=2/5/10 chunks of loads in flight (bit-exact on 1070): Nano decode 10.80/10.81/10.80/10.81 vs 10.80 at ABU=1, no gain (nvprof 133us/call was not latency-bound time)

k_gdn software-pipelined (next pass's state rows loaded before the current reductions, first pass before the gate barrier; bit-exact): Nano decode 10.65-10.73 vs 10.71-10.78, 400-tok prefill 11.87 vs 11.92, slower
P1 lane=row decode GEMV k_li on 32-row tiled weights (coalesced 512 B warp loads), k_hg on same tiles; bit-exact; 4B decode +7% ABBA
P3 chunked GDN prefill k_gdnc (state rows in registers across the chunk, 4x4) + k_abt (tiny-order alpha/beta 4 tokens per warp); bit-exact; 400-tok prefill +11.7%
k_ssqn: prompt-batch exact rms sum once per token (was redone in every Hadamard block of k_norm_xq); bit-exact; 400-tok prefill +7.2%

P6 k_fvg mixed ALU/F2F f16 rounding on NA of 4 chains (running-max overflow guard, exact recompute fallback; bit-exact): standalone bench NA=1 0.90x, NA=2 0.85x, NA=3/4 0.46x; issue bound, not F2F bound
P7 fw_expf: float-float FP32 evaluation of glibc expf in k_fw, FP64 fallback near ties/midpoints/subnormals, exhaustively certified over x<=0; bit-exact; 4k ABBA +0.45%

PQ2_0 vs PTQ1_0: same weights and GPU bytes, Q8_K epilogue k_li bench 0.997-1.016x (bandwidth bound); PQ2_0 loads 2x faster only through the CPU base-3 decode, so PTQ1_0 repack made table driven (bit-identical, E_RPCHK): 4B repack 11.9->5.3 s, equal to PQ2_0
RoPE sin via gm_sincos_sinf (glibc x86 fused sincosf, x^3 inner term at 2^-27<=|x|<2^-5): 2B 4k stream now equals the fork 64/64 (was step 21), 9B 4k 64/64, 4B golden pass, speed unchanged
P8 decode GDN fusion: k_ab+k_conv+k_l2+k_gdn+k_gnorm -> k_convl2 + k_gdnf, bit-identical; ABBA decode 9.89/9.85 vs 9.84/9.83
warp-form FWHT+Q8_0 k_xqw/k_norm_xqw (Q=2 decode, 4 prefill), bit-identical; ABBA prefill 19.30/19.30 vs 18.80/18.78
k_fsb: chunk-batched K scores + transposed 32-tree reduce, bit-identical; k_fs 2.12->0.875 s nvprof 1500 tok
k_fvg no-rescale straight-line groups + k_fvg<2,4> for chunks, bit-identical; ABBA prefill 20.63/20.61 vs 19.88, decode 10.12/10.11 vs 9.89
k_fvg next-group load prefetch + lean FD=2 loop k_fvh (float4 weights, half2 V, unpredicated full groups), bit-identical; f16r on FP32 pipe and FVU 16/32 measured out
k_fs<4,2,1> register cap (E_FSK=21) + one-F2F exact f16 rounding in k_fvh with overflow rerun (E_FVR=3), bit-identical; ABBA decode 10.22/10.22 vs 10.12/10.12
block-parallel exact rms sum k_ssqb (float-predicted binades, one u64 block scan, verified event chain, fallback), bit-identical; ABBA decode 10.54/10.58 vs 10.22/10.20
compact-code k_ssqb (branch-free rounding, smem-staged rolled loops, register-held events, 512 threads): 35.7 -> 16.7 us per call in the engine, bit-identical; ABBA decode 10.72/10.72 vs 10.57/10.58

batch rms sums on one k_ssqb block per token (E_SSQN=2, +0.8% prefill) + float4 smem-staged alpha/beta GEMV k_abt2 312 -> 115 us (E_ABT=2, +1.2% prefill), bit-identical; ABBA prefill 21.31/21.30 vs 21.06/21.05
transposed warp reduce (dotg_reduceT) in prefill k_gdnc, 8 rows per warp, v staged in smem: 806 -> 463 us per call, bit-identical; ABBA prefill 21.80/21.80 vs 21.32/21.33
